76: This [baraita] - in which it is stated "these belong to him".

To a container and flax - if a barrel is tipped over and flax is in front of it, it is certain that the flax did not fall out of the container, since if it had fallen out of it, there would be some remaining in it. The same goes for a pouch with money in front of it, for the same reason. That which it states that he is obligated [to proclaim his find] regarding a basket and produce, is because they will typically slide out, and all of it will fall out.
